derivation:
rw [mem_coordinateLattice_iff] at hv ⊢
choose z hz using hv; intro a; refine ⟨(M *ᵥ z) a, ?_⟩; rw [RingHom.map_mulVec (Int.castRingHom ℚ) M z a]; simp [matrixIntCastLieHom_eq_map, hz]
explanation: `RingHom.map_mulVec` states that a ring homomorphism carries a matrix-vector product to the product of the mapped matrix and mapped vector. Applying it to the integer cast shows each coordinate of the coerced matrix acting on an integer-coordinate vector is the cast of an integer coordinate. The current proof instead expands the coordinate sums directly.
